sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Life - Part 5 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I hope you've already noticed that some fighters walk around in pretty serious armor. You are not punching through that so easily. But the Arena has a great equalizer, a bullet to the eye! And you need to master that as soon as possible."

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,000 EXP
- 40,000 Roubles
- 10 GP coins
- Unlocks Magnum Research Desert Eagle L6 .50 AE pistol in the Armory
